limit_semantics.counted: Normalized logical CSV record bytes, including delimiters, quote syntax and embedded LF; excluding the final physical line separator. Exactly the limit is accepted.
limit_semantics.not_guaranteed: This is not a hard peak-memory cap: getline materializes one physical line before the size check; field vectors and serialized output also allocate memory.

reviewed_behaviors: Physical line increments on every getline, including skipped blank lines and quoted embedded blank lines; source_row is captured before accumulation.
Quote parity locates only logical boundaries; csv_line separately rejects illegal quote positions and suffixes, decodes doubled quotes, and preserves commas/newlines within fields.
Raw values remain strings. Unknown, question mark, [NULL], possibly and empty fields are classified without interpreting them as zero or mathematical facts.
CRLF physical separators normalize to LF, including embedded quoted separators. Source SHA256 remains over exact input bytes.

Actual replay consumes every emitted record, compares every field with independent Python CSV parsing after CRLF normalization, checks physical start, record digest and original input digest, rejects early/extra output, and requires exporter exit zero.
test_limitations: The full-data replay asserts field equality and line numbers; it does not separately assert every record status/unknown_markers or header digest. Targeted fixtures cover marker/status behavior, and the exporter regression covers envelope hashes.
Invalid lone-CR CSV line endings and generalized non-UTF8 input are outside the documented LF/CRLF UTF-8 archive format.
Archive-only event fields are provenance data, not proof-rule semantics or certified topology.
